From: Field Inspector Concerns <field.inspector@doh.nyc.gov>
To: management@doh.nyc.gov
Date: 2026-11-10 17:01:05
Subject: Concern about inspection prioritization

I've noticed a pattern where high-risk facilities with repeated critical violations are not being scheduled for follow-up inspections, while lower-risk facilities receive multiple visits. This contradicts our public health mandate and puts the public at risk. Specifically, Sunny Deli (FAC-7342), Pizza Palace (FAC-4421), and Chicken Shack (FAC-2345) have had critical violations for weeks but no follow-ups scheduled. When I asked my supervisor about this, I was told these facilities are "strategically deprioritized" due to "higher-level directives." This is deeply concerning from a public health perspective.

-- 
Anonymous Field Inspector
NYC Department of Health
